purpose: Public discussion of personal agents: product introductions, use, expectations and concerns. Query hits are candidates, not validated attitude labels.
timezone: UTC; final day truncated at collection time
language: unrestricted, language field retained locally; no machine translation
unit: unique primary search post; original/quote/reply distinctions retained
sampling: Latest search, weekly strata, at most 3 pages per product-stratum, nonrandom and incomplete

products.name: Meta Muse
products.query: ("Meta Muse" OR "Muse agent" OR "muse.ai" OR "Muse personal" OR (Muse (智能体 OR 个人助理))) -"Muse Spark" -"Muse Image" -"Muse Audio" -filter:retweets

products.name: OpenAI / ChatGPT Dots
products.query: ("ChatGPT Dots" OR "OpenAI Dots" OR "ChatGPT Dot" OR "OpenAI Dot" OR (dots ("personal agent" OR "always-on" OR "cloud computer" OR "my dot" OR "your dot" OR 智能体 OR 助理))) -filter:retweets
products.name_disambiguation: User dot interpreted as OpenAI Dots; excludes New Computer Dot and generic dot.

products.name: Grok Bot personal/work agent
products.query: ("Grok Bot" OR GrokBot OR "grok.bot") (agent OR agents OR computer OR workflow OR workflows OR assistant OR teammate OR teammates OR Cursor OR automation OR 智能体 OR 助理) -filter:retweets
products.name_disambiguation: Search can include references to the legacy @grok reply bot; relevance requires human review before substantive coding.

public_release: Post IDs only with aggregate corpus counts, code and documentation. No post text, ordinary-user profiles or individual inferences.

revisions.reason: Initial broad matches mixed generic dots and Muse model references; retained locally, not released as curated product corpus.
Exact product phrases and agent-context terms; exclusion of Muse model-only terms. Still candidate relevance, not human-validated labels.
